description: This is a PHP test class for the PurgeService in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing data purging functionalities for employee and candidate data, including various associated entities and handling of exceptions.

classes.name: PurgeServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for the PurgeService class, testing various data purging scenarios including employee and candidate data, strategy application, and exception handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of PurgeService and loading test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePurgeDao
methods.description: Tests that getPurgeDao() returns an instance of PurgeDao.

methods.name: testGetPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Verifies that getPurgeableEntities returns expected entities for a specific purge strategy.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Tests the creation of a ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy with correct match parameters.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy2
methods.description: Tests the creation of a DestroyPurgeStrategy with matching criteria.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Performs a purge of employee data and verifies the data and related entities are properly anonymized or deleted.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures that a TransactionException is raised when an error occurs during employee data purge.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy1
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data for a vacancy where candidates have not consented to keep data.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy2
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data when all candidates have consented to keep data.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy3
methods.description: Tests purging data when no candidates have applied for the vacancy.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy4
methods.description: Tests conditional purging involving candidates with mixed consent and status.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy5
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data for a vacancy with candidates who have started interviews.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Verifies exception handling during candidate data purge process.
